collection.description: An artisan speculates that a distant artificial worker might paint, compose songs, or carve figures no human has imagined.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An artisan speculates that a distant artificial worker might paint, compose songs, or carve figures no human has imagined.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A musician argues that surprising beauty matters regardless of its maker.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A carver asks whether the machine chose its subject or followed patterns supplied by others.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A painter compares it to a brush guided by a person.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A novice asks whether instruments that suggest ideas are still merely passive.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council debates whether the maker, user, or construct should receive credit.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child wonders whether an artwork can be meaningful even if no one knows who made it.
